committee: *Presentation for Legislative Certificate No. 242-38 (COR) - Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 242-38 (COR) to the volunteers of I Hinanao I Magahet Yan I Inina (HMI), commending their commitment to serving the veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces and their families. The presentation will take place on Friday, January 23, 2026, at 12:15 PM at Outback Steakhouse in Tumon. For more information about the presentation, contact the Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane at 671-989-2572 or via email at office.senatorbri@ guamlegislature.gov . 1/22/2026 3:40 P.M.
